experiment_data.hypothesis: GPT-2 PPL-scored data with uniform weighting (no provenance reweighting) serves as a baseline; without adaptive weighting, the model cannot distinguish high-quality from low-quality training data, resulting in higher holdout perplexity compared to adaptive methods.
